items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: I knew his name, his first name was Joe. ... He was secretary for the union. Celestine was the president.

ctx.x: That beats the hell out of me. I can't think of anybody who played violin and drums.

I can't think of that a while. Anyhow, he was secretary when they first set the union up there. He was secretary for the union. Celestine was the president. His name's Joe. I knew his name, his first name was Joe.
